sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (werdenfels).
Our order history for this part shows 5.26 EUR (po:4500013373-10) against 5.84 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014427-10).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).
Today you supply 20 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 36-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We accept the AS-14404 index clause on the material share with a 5% deadband; the attached base price reflects the price risk this removes for you.
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,700 kg per year over 36 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the prospect of a 36-month commitment and a larger share of your volume. 

While internal policies prevent us from sharing a detailed cost breakdown, we agree to the AS-14404 index clause to manage price risk. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Taking into account your verified price history and the extended contract term, we can revise our offer to a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a contract term of 36 months: a price of €5.60 per unit, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We acknowledge your revised offer; however, the adjustment is still too small to reach a viable agreement. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our standard offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

In response to your movement, we are prepared to offer a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

To move forward, please provide the underlying data to substantiate your binding volume commitment of 23,700 kg per year. Which volume can you commit to? 

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
